material_class.structural_family: centred nine-metal {Dy10} ring (metallocrown-like disc) with a separate Co3 counter-cation

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1 was prepared by heating a mixture of [Dy2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (0.46 g, 0.30 mmol), [Co3(μ3-O)(O2CtBu)6(py)3]·O2CtBu (1 g, 0.88 mmol), tert-butylphosphonic acid (0.07 g, 0.507 mmol) and pyridine (0.5 mL, 6.20 mmol) in acetonitrile (15 mL) for 7 h to give a dark brown solution. The solution was filtered and left undisturbed at room temperature for ten days. Light-brown crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were collected. The main text states heating for seven hours followed by crystallisation over about two weeks, with a 10–20% yield range, but does not give reagent quantities.
synthesis.temperature: heated for 7 h (temperature not numerically specified); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in acetonitrile, then filtration and undisturbed standing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered dark-brown solution left undisturbed at room temperature for ten days; light-brown X-ray-quality crystals collected.
synthesis.yield: 30 mg (10.56%) based on [Dy2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6]; main text quotes 10–20% based on lanthanide pivalate

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of polycrystalline 1 from 2–300 K shows χMT = 135.0 emu K mol−1 at room temperature, near the value for ten non-interacting DyIII ions (calc. 141.2 emu K mol−1), with a gradual then sharper decrease on cooling from depopulation of Stark levels. Magnetisation reaches 52.2 μB at 2 K and 7 T without saturation. Compound 1 does not show slow relaxation of magnetisation.

material_class.structural_family: isostructural centred nine-metal {Gd10} ring with a separate Co3 counter-cation

synthesis.procedure: Compound 2 was prepared by the same procedure as 1, replacing the dysprosium pivalate with [Gd2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (0.30 mmol). The shared conditions are reaction with [Co3(μ3-O)(O2CtBu)6(py)3]·O2CtBu (1 g, 0.88 mmol), tert-butylphosphonic acid (0.07 g, 0.507 mmol) and pyridine (0.5 mL, 6.20 mmol) in acetonitrile (15 mL) for 7 h, filtration, and standing at room temperature. Crystals of 2 did not diffract well enough for a full structure determination; the unit cell is reported and the compound is described as isostructural with 1.
synthesis.temperature: heated for 7 h (temperature not numerically specified); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 7 h reaction, then standing (SI: ten days for the shared crystallisation of 1; main text: about two weeks)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in acetonitrile, then filtration and undisturbed standing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same filtration and room-temperature crystallisation as compound 1; light-brown crystals. Only the unit cell of 2 could be determined.
synthesis.yield: 55 mg (19.24%) based on [Gd2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6]; main text quotes 10–20% based on lanthanide pivalate

properties.summary: χMT for 2 is 78.5 emu K mol−1 at room temperature (calc. 77.9 emu K mol−1 for ten GdIII), nearly constant to 20 K then falling. Magnetisation reaches 69.6 μB at 2 K and 7 T, close to saturation for ten S = 7/2, g = 2 centres (69.8 μB). Finite-temperature Lanczos fits give very weak exchange, best parameters J1 = −0.02 cm−1 (ring) and J2 = +0.01 cm−1 (centre–ring), implying frustration that would only be relevant below about 100 mK. The magnetocaloric entropy change is 28.5 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K for ΔH = 0.5–7 T, limited by the weak antiferromagnetic interactions.
